hook.text: These diamonds are shaped like a boat.

lines.text: These diamonds are shaped like a boat.
It's a marquise cut, with curved sides that meet in two points.
lines.say: It's a mar-keez cut, with curved sides that meet in two points.

lines.text: Legend says Louis XV had it cut like Madame de Pompadour's lips.
lines.say: Legend says Louis the Fifteenth had it cut like Madame de Pom-pa-door's lips.

lines.text: It's about twice as long as it is wide,
and usually has 58 facets, 33 on top and 25 below.
lines.say: and usually has fifty-eight facets, thirty-three on top and twenty-five below.

lines.text: It looks bigger than a round diamond of the same weight.
Like a pear, it can show a dark bow tie.
The points chip most easily, so V-shaped prongs often wrap them.
lines.say: The points chip most easily, so vee-shaped prongs often wrap them.

lines.text: Jackie Kennedy's engagement ring from Aristotle Onassis was a 40-carat marquise.
lines.say: Jackie Kennedy's engagement ring from Aristotle Onassis was a forty-carat mar-keez.

lines.text: The French call it navette, which means little boat.
lines.say: The French call it na-vet, which means little boat.

lines.text: A render shows the client each point before anything is cast.

post.youtube_title: What a marquise cut is: the boat-shaped diamond
post.caption: A marquise has curved sides that meet in two points, is about twice as long as it is wide and usually has 58 facets. It looks bigger than a round diamond of the same weight, and its points are usually guarded by V-shaped prongs. The renders in this video were made with HeyGema.
